title: Assemble verified local climate delivery for Fardin

acceptance.text: Verify existing v1.0.0 artifacts and local raw/prepared evidence, and assemble one copyable folder without altering the sealed package.
acceptance.evidence: Verified the existing archive (88,023,118 bytes), checksum sidecar, producer receipt, manifest and matching bootstrap against v1.0.0 identities; all 2,610 local non-document package entries pass, including 100 raw responses and 2,387 prepared files. Assembled cache/climate_delivery/Saim_to_Fardin_climate_v1.0.0 without modifying the sealed package or producer receipt. All nine sealed source hashes also match committed main2 at db37c6d.

acceptance.text: Test fresh extraction, offline validation and complete reproduction from delivery files; document consumer fields, real examples, compatibility and recipient checklist.
acceptance.evidence: Fresh extraction from the copied delivery archive verified all 2,618 payload files. Existing network-blocked workflow validated all 100 raw requests, original registry and coordinate roles, then reproduced all 2,387 derived files byte-for-byte in a separate tree with no derived inputs copied; all 222 raw/source/input files stayed unchanged. Real regional/district and monthly/chart example records were loaded from that extraction. All 110 tests passed.

acceptance.text: Record measured local delivery results and transfer instructions without claiming recipient acceptance, scientific approval, upload or application integration.
acceptance.evidence: The 13-file ignored delivery folder contains START_HERE verification/extraction/validation/loading commands and recipient checklist, trusted original components, consumer guide, four-parameter compatibility dictionary, real example and LOCAL_PRODUCER_CHECKS. Documented USB/manual transfer without assuming a device or account; new report distinguishes producer checks, unresolved science/sharing, backend/frontend responsibilities and pending recipient verification. No upload, data change, commit or push occurred.
